confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of US Sun Belt pricing for July 2026, not from live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable. Cocktail and wine are estimated from typical US bar pricing relative to draught beer. Hotel and hostel anchors are the least certain because summer rates vary widely by property, date and event demand. Restaurant prices assume Florida sales tax and typical tipping norms as applicable.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized US Sun Belt metros with similar visitor profiles, such as Orlando, Jacksonville and Charlotte, adjusted for Tampa's typically lower July hotel demand relative to winter and for Florida sales tax and Hillsborough County tourist-bed tax.
